theorem tangentConeAt.lim_zero {α : Type*} (l : Filter α) {c : α → 𝕜} {d : α → E}
    (hc : Tendsto (fun n ↦ ‖c n‖) l atTop) (hd : Tendsto (fun n ↦ c n • d n) l (𝓝 y)) :
    Tendsto d l (𝓝 0) := by
  refine .congr' ((eventually_ne_of_tendsto_norm_atTop hc 0).mono fun n hn ↦
    inv_smul_smul₀ hn (d n)) ?_
  simpa using (tendsto_inv₀_cobounded.comp (tendsto_norm_atTop_iff_cobounded.1 hc)).smul hd
